title: For Such a Time as This

request.style: English, musical theatre, a baritone as the old cousin and a mezzo-soprano as the young queen, dramatic dialogue song building to a defiant solo, theatre orchestra with brass and timpani, 96 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Everyone knows, the law of the king
Whoever goes in to him uncalled shall die
Unless he holds out the golden scepter
And I have not been called these thirty days

[Verse]
Do not think that in the king's palace
You will escape more than all the Jews
For if you keep silent at this time
Relief will rise from another place

[Chorus]
And who knows whether you have come
To the kingdom for such a time as this
Who knows, who knows
For such a time as this

[Verse]
Go, gather all the Jews in Susa
Fast for me, three days, night or day
Then I will go to the king, though it is against the law
And if I perish, I perish

[Chorus]
And who knows whether you have come
To the kingdom for such a time as this
Who knows, who knows
For such a time as this
